evals.prompt: We are offline. Before I implement a guest-mode reply, look up answerGuestQuery: which fields are required, what does it return, and what official cached source supports that? Include the source URL, SHA-256 and recorded verification time if the tools expose them. Do not infer that a puregram wrapper exists merely because Telegram documents the method.
evals.expected_output: Retrieve the cached official method, accurately report required guest_query_id and result plus the documented return, expose cache provenance without inventing timestamps, and distinguish official API availability from installed SDK support.
assertions: Retrieves official cached evidence and identifies guest_query_id and result as the required fields.
Reports the documented return and canonical method URL without inventing an SDK wrapper.
